implemented: One record for each actual capability entry, preserving source array order and /capabilities/index provenance.
Exact authored id, name, description, all twenty known schema fields, and unknown nested extension fields are preserved without runtime defaults.
Disabled, unavailable, fixed, host-handoff and legacy-admitted capabilities remain authored records; runtime routing eligibility never filters extraction.
Root registry identity, version, comment, schema reference and extensions are independently copied under derived.registry_context; the capabilities array is not duplicated.
Nested source maps, lists, explicit null, empty containers, authored string dates and pointer-special keys round-trip through the common property serializer.
Trusted committed Draft7 schema validates all known envelope/entry/admission fields; additional keys are accepted and retained for forward-compatible field exposure.

Missing historical store returns []; present empty array is valid; malformed JSON, malformed present records, invalid registry identity, duplicate ids and source paths outside the snapshot fail explicitly.
No snapshot Python, runtime adapter, schema URL, execution binding, decision reference, permission string or legacy registry is executed or followed.
Components are preserved only when explicitly authored; no inferred component association or runtime registry_origin is added.
validation_dependency: Uses jsonschema already declared in knowledge/requirements-neo4j.txt and config/capability_registry.schema.json resolved from the trusted reader installation, not from the source snapshot.

verification.lint: ruff format and ruff check --no-cache passed for both owned Python implementation/test files

mutation_proofs.method: Process-local mutations of the actually imported knowledge.native_types.capability module; no source files changed by the mutation runner.

integration_boundary: Shared graph mapping, complete loader reachability, live Neo4j publication and Aura UI verification remain coordinator responsibilities. This report makes no deployed database claim.
